mapper.select: SELECT id, travel_plan_day_id, content, tag, display_order, created_by_member_id, version, created_at, updated_at FROM travel_plan_items WHERE travel_plan_day_id = #{travelPlanDayId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT i.id, i.travel_plan_day_id, i.content, i.tag, i.display_order, i.created_by_member_id, i.version, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM travel_plan_items i JOIN travel_plan_days d ON d.id = i.travel_plan_day_id WHERE d.travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} ORDER BY d.day_number ASC, i.display_order ASC, i.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_plan_items item JOIN (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC) AS new_order FROM travel_plan_items WHERE travel_plan_day_id = #{travelPlanDayId}) ordered ON ordered.id = item.id SET item.display_order = ordered.new_order WHERE item.travel_plan_day_id = #{travelPlanDayId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, travel_plan_day_id, content, tag, display_order, created_by_member_id, version, created_at, updated_at FROM travel_plan_items WHERE travel_plan_day_id = #{travelPlanDayId} AND display_order < #{displayOrder} ORDER BY display_order DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, travel_plan_day_id, content, tag, display_order, created_by_member_id, version, created_at, updated_at FROM travel_plan_items WHERE travel_plan_day_id = #{travelPlanDayId} AND display_order > #{displayOrder} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_plan_items SET content = #{content}, tag = #{tag}, created_by_member_id = #{createdByMemberId}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND travel_plan_day_id = #{travelPlanDayId}
